## The Short Version

The [Earth Optimization Prize](earth-optimization-prize.qmd) [@earth-optimization-prize-paper-2025] is a public mechanism for discovering, stress-testing, and coordinating around the best available integrated plan for moving humanity off its current trajectory.

That trajectory is not neutral. The [destructive economy](../economics/gdp-trajectories.qmd) [@gdp-trajectories-paper-2025] is already {{< var global_destructive_economy_pct_gdp >}} of GDP, reaches the failed-state danger zone in {{< var destructive_economy_years_to_25pct_gdp >}}, and reaches 50% of GDP in {{< var destructive_economy_years_to_50pct_gdp >}}. At that point, stealing beats creating, because whatever gets created gets looted as fast as it is produced.

The benchmark upside of changing branch is similarly large. The [Minimum Sustainable Trajectory (1% Treaty)](../economics/gdp-trajectories.qmd) [@1-pct-treaty-impact-paper-2025] adds {{< var treaty_trajectory_lifetime_income_gain_per_capita >}} in lifetime income and {{< var treaty_hale_gain_year_15 >}} of healthy life by year 15. The [Wishonian](../futures/wishonia.qmd) [Optimal Governance Trajectory](../economics/gdp-trajectories.qmd) adds {{< var wishonia_trajectory_lifetime_income_gain_per_capita >}} and {{< var wishonia_hale_gain_year_15 >}}.

## What We Are Asking You To Do

Host the first 90-day pilot.

That means:

1. publish the rules,
2. convene the panel,
3. fund red-team bounties,
4. launch the first public scoreboard,
5. admit the first serious submissions and public commitments.

It does **not** mean:

1. endorsing `Earth Optimization Protocol v1` as final truth,
2. becoming the root of trust,
3. controlling all future hosts or implementations,
4. funding the entire downstream campaign.

## Why This Is A Good Institutional Role

1. It is a high-leverage epistemic intervention. You are hosting the process that finds and stress-tests better plans.
2. It is a bounded public-good program. The outputs are concrete: rules, panel, bounty pool, scoreboard, submissions.
3. It is reputationally safer than endorsing an ideology. The institution sponsors an open constitutional convention with adversarial review.
4. It creates visible public infrastructure other institutions can later join.

## Why This Is Not A Blank-Sheet Bet

Large parts of the software base already exist:

1. **[Optimitron](https://optomitron.com)** is live.
2. **[Optimitron repository](https://github.com/mikepsinn/optomitron)** is public.
3. The evidence engine, [Wishocracy](../solution/wishocracy.qmd) [@wishocracy-paper-2025], policy/budget generators, identity/referral plumbing, and treasury packages are materially implemented.
4. The codebase includes roughly 2,900+ tests across the workspace.

The pilot is therefore an attempt to host and legitimize a public coordination layer on top of already substantial implementation work.

## What Success Looks Like In 90 Days

By day 90, success means:

1. a public challenge page exists,
2. a named review panel exists,
3. a public adversarial-review bounty pool exists,
4. a live scoreboard exists,
5. the first credible submissions and critiques are public.

That is enough to turn the project from an interesting paper stack into live public infrastructure.

## The Core Governance Principle

**One institution may initiate the network. No institution should be able to stop it.**

The right host is credible enough to launch the process and disciplined enough not to capture it.
